reply:
Good afternoon Chidi,

Thanks for following up on INV-88. I checked transfer TRF-INV-88 (₦250,000 to Access Bank, account 0234567891). Although it still shows as "failed" on our side, I asked Access Bank to confirm the final status, and they confirmed the money was credited to your account on 21 November 2026 at 2:02 pm (UTC).

Because the bank confirms the funds were sent, I have not re-sent the payment, as that would result in a duplicate ₦250,000 credit to you.

If the funds are not showing in your account, please check with your Access Bank branch first and reply with any details they give you (such as a credited amount or date). I can then escalate this to our human team and the bank for further tracing.
